target_audience: Undergraduate Students in STEM / Future Educators

sections.title: Introduction: The Goal of Mathematical Clarity
lecture_lines: Mathematical explanation bridges formal proof and intuition.
animations: Animate a line from a 'Proof' box to an 'Intuition' box meeting at a center 'Understanding' nexus.
Fade in three color-coded boxes: 'Accuracy' (#FF0000), 'Logical Flow' (#00FF00), 'Cognitive Economy' (#00FF00).
Animate a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bridge.svg] drawing itself across the screen connecting the pillars.

sections.title: Pillar 1: Precision and Representational Accuracy
animations: Display a graph failing the vertical line test using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/graph.svg]. Color: #FF0000.
Draw a vertical line sweeping across the X-axis over the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/graph.svg]. Color: #FFFFFF.
Highlight points on the curve of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/graph.svg] where the line intersects more than once. Color: #FF0000.

sections.title: Pillar 2: Building Intuition via Visual Scaffolding
lecture_lines: Use transitions for deeper conceptual understanding.
animations: Display a curved path with a small [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/squirrel.svg] icon on it. Color: #FFCC00.
Draw a secant line connecting two points on the curve. Color: #FFFFFF.
Zoom in on the curve until it visually appears as a straight line. Color: #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Pillar 3: Logical Sequencing (The 'Why' Before the 'How')
animations: Display a logic map using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/map.svg] with 'Problem', 'Method', 'Result' labels. Color: #FFFFFF.
Chain connection of logic blocks within [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/map.svg], illuminating them one by one. Color: #00FF00.

sections.title: Conclusion: The Feedback Loop
animations: Display a summary checklist of the three pillars. Color: #FFFFFF.
Highlight each pillar as a 'check' mark appears using. Color: #00FF00.
Animate the Pythagorean theorem proof appearing as the completed result using. Color: #FFFFFF.
